scope: 407 frozen technology stocks; 2023-12-29 close decisions through 2026-10-27 close; first execution 2024-01-02
philosophy: Low win rate accepted; tail contribution and payoff/cumulative trial cost are primary. No optimization of win rate.
common_events: One stock/source/E0 contiguous active epoch intersecting the study, including carry-in, zero-fill and right-censored epochs. Universe and equal event weights frozen before economic calculation.
primary_weights: Equal initial shadow cash per common event; sum all paired outcomes. Stock-equal/event-equal-within-stock is a robustness appendix with frozen denominators. No changing weights by fills or closure.

arms.I: First executable original I daily event satisfying shared nonportfolio eligibility, at most one entry per E0 epoch.
arms.S: First executable original I daily event AND frozen strict_target, allowing later entry in same epoch. strict_target alone creates no order.
arms.D: Diagnostic only: copy I if strict_target true at its first actual-fill decision, otherwise cash for epoch. Not actual S policy.

eligibility: Reuse original stock/sector/source/availability/readiness eligibility; no ACT, ranking competition, slots, 2% sizing, 10% cash buffer or 0.25% risk gate. Rank readiness retained as inherited data contract.
execution: Reuse frozen native Decimal ledger, FillWindow, quantity and fee contracts; signal-close gross/share cap; next eligible A-market open only. Buy order expires at that intended execution session close including suspended/no-bar days. Zero fill may apply again only on a new original I event; partial fill counts as the one entry and remainder expires. Exit intents latch until legally filled.
costs: original cost2, with frozen component-specific exceptions and stressed slippage
prices_actions: Frozen raw OHLC for execution/valuation; frozen causal factor for support; corporate actions, original fractional split policy, dividend net proxy, settlement and T+1 preserved. No trading account access.
exit: Original I/E0 invalidity or original stored support violation, common to both arms; no fast protection, add, reentry after actual entry or ACT. At E0 source boundary exit only when observable, never retroactively.
terminal: All common events enter primary outcomes, including terminal held inventory and pending entitlements. Actual cashflows and unrealized raw-close marks separated; marks are not fills. Estimated liquidation fee separately disclosed, not charged as actual. Closed-only results supplementary.
tail: Existing net_pnl/(buy_gross+buy_fees)>=0.30, separate realized closed tails and terminal mark-based tails. Fixed I reference tail set plus each-arm tails; continuous contribution distribution and all top-I contribution event retention/delay/difference diagnostic. Labels never enter decisions.
effects: saved_negative_loss=L_I-L_S; foregone_positive=G_I-G_S; total_delta=saved_negative_loss-foregone_positive. Fixed-I-tail delta plus complementary ordinary delta equals total. Static deletion=D-I; delayed participation=S-D; exact total decomposition.
verdict: Pareto ordinary/tail improvement is sufficient, not necessary, support. Ordinary cost increase outweighed by tail benefit is a disclosed positive tradeoff, not failure. Dominated outcomes support rejection of this S policy. Mixed signs, cost reversal, weak coverage or main/robustness reversal are inconclusive; never choose favorable basis. No p-value or win-rate target.
correctness: Native fee/rounding contract exact; independent fill/fee/action/cash/share/NAV reconciliation with precision-explained Decimal residue, not arbitrary 1e-8 engineering gate. Event identity and causal timestamps exact. Always-allow gate reproduces I. Physical-prefix checks on representative data.
budget: Representative sample verification before full economics. Full calculation wall budget 300s, development excluded. If exceeded retain checkpoint/timing and optimize cache/scan, never launch long portfolio matrix.
limits: First participation per E0 epoch only; not actual portfolio I reattempts following ACT/forced exits or reallocation. Already-seen current-survivor/classification/cap snapshot, daily HLV execution proxy, not out-of-sample or executable pooled performance.
stop: One frozen rule set and two cost contracts. No parameter search, new indicators, products, live/paper accounts, downloads or interference with other tasks.
